$comment: Contract between backend and page. Source of truth: docs/designs/blob_design.md, section 'WebSocket protocol'. Every JSON message is an object with a string field 'type'. A message marked binary is followed, on the same socket, by exactly one WebSocket binary frame (the hub writes both under a lock, so nothing else comes between them).

close_codes.4401: no valid session cookie on the upgrade, or a foreign Origin (client must not retry; the page sends the browser to /auth/login). A page with another version gets hello_ok{ok:false} first so it reloads

timer_item.left_s: float (seconds until it fires, when the snapshot was built)

utterance.binary: when dur_ms > 0: raw little-endian signed 16-bit mono PCM, 16000 Hz

fields.rate: int 16000 (send the number; the backend also accepts the string)

wake_clip.binary: raw little-endian signed 16-bit mono PCM, 16000 Hz (at most 10 s)

fields.label: pos | neg | auto: an enrollment sample of the wake phrase, of other speech, or an attempt the wake word heard (peak >= 0.1)
fields.peak: float 0..1, highest wake word score over the clip

fields.alerts: alert_item[] (active alerts only; empty before S4)
fields.timers: timer_item[] (pending source=timer alerts, soonest first; the on-screen countdown)

tts.binary: one complete WAV file (S1: the whole reply)

fields.timings: {stt_ms, hermes_ms, tts_ms, first_audio_ms, sc1_ms} (numbers or null)

fields.present: bool|null (null: unknown, no sensor reported or DELETE /presence; the page behaves as with no sensor)
fields.since_s: float|null (seconds since the current value started, when sent)

GET /device-config.response: {device, sound, wake, quiet_hours, followup_listen_s, listen_no_speech_s, silence_rms, debug_audio, night}; night is {start, end} (HH:MM, browser local time) from NIGHT_HOURS, or null when night mode is off; device is the user's name, sound and wake come from the user's Pocket ID groups (OIDC_SOUND_GROUP, OIDC_WAKE_GROUP)
GET /device-config.presence: also presence_sleep_s (float, PRESENCE_SLEEP_S): with nobody in the room the screen goes dark this long after the last activity

http.GET /auth/login?next=<path>: 302 to the OIDC provider (authorization code + PKCE); 502 when the provider is unreachable
http.GET /auth/callback: 303 to next with the session cookie set; 400 expired or foreign state, 403 refused by the provider, 502 token checks failed
http.POST /auth/logout: 204; deletes the session and clears the cookie

POST /alerts.body: {key, source, text, urgency?, lang?, fire_at?|in_s?, ttl_s?, repeat?}; repeat is 'daily HH:MM', 'weekly mon,thu HH:MM' or 'every N days HH:MM' (local time, TZ), not with in_s
POST /alerts.response: 201 new / 200 update {key, state, fire_at, repeat}; 422 invalid; 429 over 20 active

GET /alerts.response: array of {key, state, fire_at, repeat}; repeat is null for a one-off alert

POST /presence.body: {present: bool} (strict JSON boolean; any other field gets 422)
POST /presence.response: 200 {present, since_s}; every screen gets a presence message

DELETE /presence.response: 204; back to unknown (present null), as with no sensor

notes: alert_read: a failed synthesis or an unknown key answers error{bad_message}; a tap before the models load answers error{not_ready}
tts.followup is set for every device; the page must ignore it on devices with wake=false
wake_clip: the page sends it only when /device-config says debug_audio=true; the backend drops the clip when DEBUG_AUDIO_DIR is unset

presence: sent on connect right after the snapshot only when a sensor has reported (present not null), and to every client on each POST or DELETE /presence. A page that loses its socket treats presence as unknown until told again
